latest_update.text: Salam, subitem breakdown for Phase 2 Backlog, future state, not building now: Lead scoring model (incident to treatment gap, fault type): Sharif's own framework. Strongest signal is the gap between date of incident and date of first treatment, 2+ weeks untreated usually means decline barring rare circumstances. Fault type matters, rear ended beats left turn liability. Severity/surgery usually isn't knowable until months into treatment. Build once volume justifies it, Sharif's words were "when there's volume." Incident and treatment date fields already live in Pipeline Build. AI document auto labeling, gated on compliance confirmation: renaming uploaded images by what they are (license, insurance card). Sharif is fine with it as long as data never leaves Flow Company plus the firm. Medical

latest_update.text: Salam, Context : Regular Google Business Profile posting is a ranking factor for Google Maps that we are not currently leveraging across the client base. Similar to blog content for organic SEO, consistent GBP posts signal activity and relevance to Google's local algorithm, and can improve visibility in map pack results and local search. Deliverable : Develop and document a repeatable GBP posting strategy for this client, including recommended post frequency (weekly, biweekly, etc.), content types (updates, offers, events, services), and sourcing workflow (who drafts, who approves, how we maintain the cadence without client bottlenecks). Next step : Hashir and Zayan to audit the current GBP , review what competitors or high-ranking locals are doing, and propose a specific posting cadence a
latest_update.summary: Context : Regular Google Business Profile posting is a ranking factor for Google Maps
